heroText: Tofino works best as a base in Canada when you anchor days around Long Beach, Chesterman Beach and Cox Bay. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Tofino International Airport handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.
